array_geometry.source: Panels on the six side faces of a hexagonal body: at the pole the Sun stays near the horizon, where a flat top deck collects almost nothing. Not a published design.

array_area_m2.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
array_area_m2.source: One side face: a hexagon 1.57 m across flats has 0.91 m sides; a panel 1 m tall with 90 % packing is 0.8 m2.

cell_efficiency.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
cell_efficiency.source: Typical space triple-junction cell efficiency, 28 to 30 %, less assembly losses.

dust_loss_fraction.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
dust_loss_fraction.source: A round allowance for plume-lofted dust on the panel; no measurement.

battery_capacity_wh.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
battery_capacity_wh.source: About 5 h at 200 W, the only power figure found for this class (unverified).

initial_soc_fraction.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
initial_soc_fraction.source: Full at the start of the window.

avionics_w.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
avionics_w.source: Half of the 200 W class figure.

payload_w.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
payload_w.source: A quarter of the 200 W class figure.

load_dissipation_fraction.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
load_dissipation_fraction.source: Nearly all electrical load ends as heat in the bus; 10 % left as radiated or transmitted power.

heater_power_w.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
heater_power_w.source: About 30 % of the 200 W class figure.

heater_setpoint_c.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
heater_setpoint_c.source: 10 K above the operational threshold below.

initial_bus_temp_c.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated

operational_min_c.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
operational_min_c.source: Typical avionics qualification lower limit, as used in the project's improvement spec.

survival_min_c.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
survival_min_c.source: Typical non-operating lower limit, as used in the project's improvement spec.

bus_absorptivity.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
bus_absorptivity.source: Light-coloured thermal blanket or paint, solar absorptivity 0.2 to 0.4.

bus_side_area_m2.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
bus_side_area_m2.source: 1.57 m width times an assumed 2.0 m bus height.

bus_top_area_m2.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
bus_top_area_m2.source: The top deck is the solar panel; it is not counted as bus.

bus_emissivity.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
bus_emissivity.source: Typical for painted or blanketed spacecraft surface.

regolith_emissivity.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
regolith_emissivity.source: Typical value used for lunar regolith in thermal models.

regolith_absorptivity.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
regolith_absorptivity.source: One minus an albedo of about 0.12.

view_factor.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
view_factor.source: Half the base's view is the ground for a body standing on legs.

base_area_m2.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
base_area_m2.source: Hexagonal footprint of 1.57 m across flats.

radiator_emissivity.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated

radiator_area_m2.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
radiator_area_m2.source: Sized so the bus holds near 15 C with the loads above; a guess.

heat_capacity_j_per_k.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
heat_capacity_j_per_k.source: 675 kg dry mass at about 600 J/kg/K for a mixed aluminium and electronics bus.

face_count.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
face_count.source: A hexagonal body has six side faces.

face_azimuth_offset_deg.no_margin_reason: a figure given as an input; no margin was stated
face_azimuth_offset_deg.source: One face towards north; the resting heading is not known before landing.

model.solar_irradiance: 1361 W/m2 at 1 au scaled by (1 au / Sun distance)^2, the distance taken from the track
model.lit: the Sun's centre above the skyline (the track's lit arcs); no partial-disc fraction is available

not_modelled: Solar-panel temperature and cell degradation (efficiency is the number entered).
Multi-node thermal gradients: the bus is one lumped node at one temperature.
Multi-layer insulation detail: it is inside the emissivities and areas entered.
Heat conducted through the landing legs into the ground.
Light and infrared reflected from sunlit terrain onto the lander.
Shading of one array face by the lander or by another face.
Battery charge and discharge efficiency, ageing, and temperature limits on charging.
The ground's temperature through the lunar day: Diviner gives only an annual average and an annual maximum, so the ground in the dark is a range, not a curve.
The Sun's partial-disc fraction at the skyline: a step an arc edge falls in is lit for the share of it inside the arc.
